decisions.heap allocation and retirement: Snapshot the guest token at successful allocation. Original bare lParam is initially native, and LB_DIR assigns its guest result only after putstr16. Unwind after construction or copyback must consume only the captured allocation; an ordinary free without clearing that key risks a second release. Separate points are distinct converter sites. Existing historical negative controls in batch-p138-checkpoint.json and fresh transaction cases.
decisions.WM32CBDir: The cleanup stage reads the acquisition mode before clearing it. Moving the snapshot from function entry to that arm restores original entry structure. Borrowed map and owned heap still need separate handling even if the runtime mapping flag changes between construction and release. R1349 remains a pending partial reduction.
